# HEM v0.6.1b25 — Readable information in every settings menu

This beta corrects the settings information disclosure layout after the unified Home, Room and Device menus in b24.

- **Root cause:** the expanded information paragraph shared a flex row with the setting label, within a disclosure whose natural width was only large enough for the info icon. Long text wrapped a character per line.
- **Fix:** the setting label and information icon now form the disclosure's summary; its help paragraph expands into a normal full-width block above the unchanged setting editor and Apply button.
- **Responsive:** native settings rows use zero-minimum-width grid tracks; help paragraphs preserve their line breaks, wrap normally at word boundaries, and break exceptionally long tokens only when required.
- **Menu audit:** the same renderer fixes native Home, Room and Device settings. Room Options and Home Options helper text already display as full-width blocks; card information uses the independent top-layer popover and remains unchanged.
- **Regression protection:** an actual Chromium test checks native help disclosure geometry, keyboard-compatible native details toggles, unchanged Apply control state, and no horizontal overflow for EN/EL/DE at 320, 390 and 760 px.

No control-policy change, configuration migration, physical-device command, Home Assistant restart, or HACS packaging change is included.
